provenance: This decompositional question and its preliminary numbers were explored AFTER outcome access. It is not a preregistered analysis and does not upgrade prior evidence class.

estimand.microcosm_unit: Each experimental replicate microcosm, not its contained patches or sampled species
estimand.specialist: Didinium nasutum > 0 OR Dileptus anser > 0 at day 21
estimand.joint: Both generalist and any specialist survive in the same metacommunity; not same-patch contact
estimand.source_handling: Never recode suspect source row 6HoLM1. Exclude it BEFORE reading its focal densities.
estimand.strata: Each n=4 or 6 patches x 3 matrix x 3 corridor cells; compare four planned hetero versus four homogeneous units at each of 18 strata
estimand.decomposition: Within each treatment arm: P_joint = P_generalist * P_specialist + (P_joint - P_generalist*P_specialist). Compare hetero minus homogeneous and average equally across strata.
estimand.missingness: Original planned four replicates in each arm; 5 missing/ambiguous units each take one of four binary (G,S) states (00/01/10/11), 4^5=1024 completions
estimand.bounds: Min and max of each component over all 1024 complete five-unit assignments; component extrema may occur in different assignments, thus ranges cannot be naively added as if jointly attained.
estimand.interpretation: Product term is a descriptive independence benchmark. Residual is within-treatment-cell cross-experiment binary covariance, not causally identified biotic facilitation or a randomization-based comparison.
estimand.observed_only: Show component point estimates over available n=3/4 microcosms separately from complete-case missingness bounds.
estimand.interaction: Six-patch minus four-patch heterogeneity contrast decomposed the same way. Cannot infer a true patch-count effect because heterogeneity intensity is confounded.
